Module com.example.miniproyecto3_battleship
Package com.example.miniproyecto3_battleship.model.ships

Class Ship

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
javafx.scene.layout.Pane
com.example.miniproyecto3_battleship.model.ships.Ship
All Implemented Interfaces:
IShip, javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
Direct Known Subclasses:
Destructor, Fragata, Portaaviones, Submarino
public class Ship extends javafx.scene.layout.Pane implements IShip
Represents a ship in the game.

The Ship class defines the basic properties and behaviors of a ship in the Battleship game. It includes attributes such as position, size, orientation (horizontal or vertical), and destruction status. This class provides methods for manipulating the ship's appearance and state, including rotation and selection for placement.

Author:
Juan David Lopez Vanegas

      public void selectDesing()
      Description copied from interface: IShip
      Applies a glowing effect to the ship to indicate it is selected.

      This method adds a white glow effect to the ship to visually represent that it has been selected. It also sets the isSelect flag to true.

      Specified by:
      selectDesing in interface IShip

    • originDesing

      public void originDesing()
      Description copied from interface: IShip
      Restores the ship's original design and removes the selection effect.

      This method removes the glow effect applied during selection and resets the ship's visual appearance to its original state. It also sets the isSelect flag to false.

      Specified by:
      originDesing in interface IShip

    • rotateShip

      public void rotateShip()
      Description copied from interface: IShip
      Rotates the ship's orientation by 90 degrees.

      If the ship is currently horizontal, this method will rotate it to a vertical orientation, and vice versa. It updates the isHorizontal flag accordingly.

      Specified by:
      rotateShip in interface IShip
